{{Quote|Hey I've got just the baby for you! Isn't she a beaut?|The salesman|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A '''salesman''' worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. He claimed to have a slightly used starship in peak condition with less than a 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] of use for sale for 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He told prospective buyers not to worry about the corrosion on the power cables.<ref name="RPG" />
